_comment: TEMPLATE. Copy to ideation_config.json beside this file and fill in the three <...> credentials; that copy is gitignored and must never be committed. Defaults for the hypothesis-batch P1 generation passes. Anything already exported in the shell wins over the value here, so configure by `export VAR=...` rather than by editing this file. Loaded by p1_env.sh beside it; point IDEATION_CONFIG at another file to swap the whole set. MECHANIC_DB_MAX_RESULTS_INTERP / _SCIATLAS are how many papers each mechanic-db half contributes to the prompt after reranking. The retrieval shape itself (total top-k, which databases are searched, whether to rerank) is fixed in ai_scientist/tools/mechanic_db.py and is deliberately not configurable here.
